GitHub user Jokser opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/4227

IGNITE-8768 Implemented eviction stopping to prevent possible JVM crush

You can merge this pull request into a Git repository by running:

$ git pull https://github.com/gridgain/apache-ignite ignite-8768

Alternatively you can review and apply these changes as the patch at:

https://github.com/apache/ignite/pull/4227.patch

To close this pull request, make a commit to your master/trunk branch
with (at least) the following in the commit message:

This closes #4227

IGNITE-8768 Implemented eviction stop during cache group stopping. Reworked evictor class.

commit 5a3e74a9b4a2bf93c865c4eeb94cf914d2da69e2
Author: Pavel Kovalenko <jokserfn@...>
Date: 2018-06-19T14:37:34Z

IGNITE-8768 Complete eviction future before log error.

Fix is ready. Now PartitionsEvictor is stopped explicitly during cache group stop.
TC link: https://ci.ignite.apache.org/project.html?projectId=IgniteTests24Java8&branch_IgniteTests24Java8=pull%2F4227%2Fhead

Jokser, I do not like that we wait for the complete partition eviction during a node shutdown. I think we can pass some sort of a status monitor to stop partition clear process during the node stop into tryClear() method. Otherwise, a node with a large persisted database will be stopping indefinitely long time.
